## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org)
- [ ] The repository's local gate passes (`nix flake check`, or its equivalent)
- [ ] Behaviour changes are covered by a test
- [ ] Public API changes are documented
- [ ] `Co-authored-by:` trailers credit everyone who worked on this
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked `BREAKING CHANGE:` in the commit body
